inspection_method: git object inspection and partial working-tree inspection because normal Windows checkout failed on query-string-like image filenames; inspected README, mkdocs.yml, docs tree, GitHub Pages workflow, pre-commit config, Makefile, and invalid-path examples

anchors.why: Describes a personal wiki published as an online MkDocs book and points contributors to issue/PR/edit paths.
Defines a very large manually curated navigation hierarchy across life, work, technical, and knowledge topics.
Contains many personal wiki pages grouped into topic directories.
Runs dependency updates, formatting, newsletter generation, commits, pushes, builds, and deploys on schedule/push.
Uses whitespace, large-file, merge-conflict, private-key, prose, markdown, safety, pip compile, and YAML lint hooks.
Windows checkout failed on filenames containing question marks, showing concrete retention/sync portability risk.

known_limits: The wiki is explicitly personal and should not be treated as reviewed VAKS knowledge.
Automation that commits and pushes generated changes must not be copied into VAKS without explicit approval.
Checkout failure on Windows means source retention needs object inspection or filename normalization.
